candidate_provenance.prompt: Candidate A. Create one editorial illustration for The Daily AI Pulse. Placement article-hero, wide horizontal 16:9 master. Subject Build a Read-Only MCP Server for Northstar Helpdesk. Verified context: a fictional local MCP server exposes narrow order lookup and bounded policy search, plus a fixed policy catalog; the implementation exposes no refund, arbitrary file, shell or network-fetch tool. The read-only annotation is advisory and the code enforces the interface. Visual idea: a pale limestone archive block exposes a few blank cream paper cards through one narrow terracotta-lined opening. A concrete physical metaphor of a small viewing window into a limited set of records, not a literal computer sandbox. The block is a sculptural archival object, with thick stone mass surrounding a shallow horizontal viewing aperture; two or three blank paper leaves sit just behind the aperture, their curled edges clearly visible, no text on them. Single central object, three-quarter elevated view, tactile mineral grain and subtle paper texture, soft light and fine edges. Restrained contemporary editorial illustration with quiet scientific/architectural sensibility. Warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, ink #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B, sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Spacious background, deliberate geometry, strong thumbnail silhouette, subtle physical depth, refined illustration quality. Central complete object inside the middle 55 percent of the composition, generous negative space so 21:9 desktop and 3:2 card crops preserve the aperture and cards. Match the production archive's tactile paper/terracotta/stone materiality and compositional confidence. This is an artwork asset inside an existing page, never a generated webpage. Not a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon system or minimalist architecture diagram. NO words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, buttons, badges, charts, watermark, neon, robots, AI brains, page parts, screenshot imitation, border or frame. High resolution, clean wordless horizontal artwork.
